svg.aria-label: Mock backend CPU per second at I/O-bound 70 percent
svg.text: At I/O-bound 70 % the mock backend, not the server, hits its limit — and only under D
mock JVM CPU per second of the 60 s window (pidstat; two CPUs, so 200 % is its ceiling) · one line per trial, 10 fresh JVMs per arm · campaign 20261013T191957Z
D: in 9 of 10 trials the mock jumps to 165–200 % at second 53 and stays ~11 points higher; the one trial without the jump is D's fastest (p99 39 ms).
A_iso and C_iso never leave 126–149 %. The server's carriers and reactors rise in the same second; in the diagnostic trials no connection churn, GC pause or pinning accompanied it (§5.5).
